messages:
maria: Heads-up — blueprint account bring-up scheduled Wed 22:00 UTC. Final checklist before we open traffic: quota reservation, autoscale policy, KMS keys, warmup script, smoke loadtest, rollback plan. Who's owners for each?

 tom: I own quota & infra. Reserved pool created (10 shards), slot IDs: shard-az1..az3. Need to confirm KMS access for the customer.

 adarsh: SRE ack. Autoscale policy drafted: target_util 70%, cooldown 90s, max_shards 12, min_shards 3. Canary route config ready. Will attach policy to pool by Tue EOD.

 lee: ML ack. Priming run completed using customer prompt set (seeded 2M tokens). KV cache primed; quantized model (8-bit) validated on latency tests — p95 within SLO. Fallback plan: route to full-precision variant if quality drops > 5% on eval set.

 sam: CS/enablement — I'll run a pre-call 1h before start with customer PM and ops. Will capture contact + escalation channel. Also collecting their warmup traffic shape (spikes vs steady).

 tom: KMS: need a cross-account key policy insert — @maria can you share the customer KMS ARN? Also confirm billing contact for reserved commit.

 maria: KMS ARN sent to you DM. Billing on file. Also: customer asked for a short smoke script we can run from their side — they prefer a curl snippet.

 lee: dropping the smoke test here: 
```bash
# minimal smoke request to verify model + auth
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"blueprint-v1","input":"Hello"}'
```
Use the dedicated endpoint we provided (region-specific).

 tom: ops loadtest plan (short): we'll run a smoke ramp then a 30m soak with k6 from two regions. Command: 
```bash
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 30m smoke.js
# smoke.js will replay 1:1 user prompts and assert HTTP 200 + <1s median latency
```
I'll post the ticket with runbook and rollback steps.

 adarsh: rollback notes: if error rate > 3% or p95 latency > 2s for >5m, we switch traffic to hosted fallback model and scale pool down. Ops oncall will run the revert script: `./revert-to-hosted.sh <blueprint>`

 deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: 2024-03-06T22:00:00Z - 2024-03-06T23:30:00Z. Canary route enabled for 10% traffic, metric hooks: latency, error-rate, token-cost.

 sam: I'll monitor customer slack and be on the call. Also collecting feedback form link to send post-run.

 maria: Nice. Quick checklist copy for final: 
- [x] quotas provisioned (tom)
- [x] autoscale policy attached (adarsh pending Tue EOD)
- [x] priming done (lee)
- [x] KMS access confirmed (tom)
- [x] smoke & loadtest script ready (tom/lee)
- [x] enablement call scheduled (sam)
- [x] rollback plan in place (adarsh)

maria: If no blockers we proceed. I'll be oncall that night (maria). :thumbsup:
